values.note: Standard water and electric $49 a night, deluxe pull-thru water and electric $52, premium pull-thru full hookup $54. Rates for 2 adults and 3 children; overnight guests $10. Long-stay discounts: 8-15 days 10%, 16-31 days 20%, with metered electric. Campspot adds its own booking fee.

note: In Hanover across US-2 from the Androscoggin River, nearest full-service campground to Grafton Notch SP, 7 mi from Sunday River; premium pull-thrus fit any size rig; pool. --Claude
